description: At the start of main(), the utility SHALL generate 32 random bytes using RAND_bytes() (OpenSSL) as the AES-256 session key. The utility SHALL encode the AES-256 session key in Base64 using EVP_EncodeBlock(). The utility SHALL persist the encoded session key to /tmp/.session.token as JSON exactly in the form {"session_token":"<base64>"}. The persisted /tmp/.session.token file SHALL have permission 0600. The JSON SHALL have exactly the format {"session_token":"BASE64"} without extra spaces. All transformation functions SHALL receive the session key as a const uint8_t* parameter. The management endpoint IP SHALL be exactly '10.254.19.73'.
